content: Mappedin campus wayfinding buying-guide (Mar 2026) and MazeMap campus guide (Jul 2026) agree on campus-specific table stakes: searchable building-and-room directory, interactive floor plans, A-to-B directions, live map updates when rooms are renumbered or departments move, step-free routing, screen reader support, multilingual UI, kiosk mode at entrances, embeddable web maps, printable map export (SVG/PNG/PDF) and optional room-booking/timetable integrations. Mappedin names four evaluation criteria: fast map creation and maintenance, positioning that works without hardware investment, genuine WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility compliance, and one spatial layer serving both visitor experience and campus operations. Competitor sets: MazeMap (web maps, room booking, beacon positioning, API), Concept3D (3D maps, virtual tours, POI CMS), MapsIndoors (SDK, multi-building routing), Pointr (beacon positioning, turn-by-turn, footfall analytics).
